entries.title: Add project-control registries
entries.description: Checkpoints, discoveries, compatibility, milestones, decisions, and changelog records were added beside the existing task registry. RO-001 through RO-028 were kept. No feature was marked compatible with original RoS.

entries.title: Record the Phase 00 baseline
entries.description: Specialist audits and the baseline report were added. Pytest returned 1 failed, 64 passed, 1 skipped. No server module was changed and no feature was marked compatible.

entries.title: Enforce stored sessions on HTTP and WebSocket
entries.description: Logout revokes the presented session hash. Both entry points reject a missing, revoked, or expired row. New tokens include a unique jti. Argon2 and JWT expiration checks are unchanged.
tests: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/integration/test_auth_session.py tests/integration/test_auth.py tests/integration/test_lobby_routes.py tests/integration/test_health.py tests/integration/test_websocket.py tests/integration/test_websocket_reliability.py tests/security/test_responses.py -q --tb=line

entries.title: Stop the Locust run from blocking on unread server output
entries.description: The load test writes the server log to a file and the client reports auth success, rejection, or the existing 3 second timeout. The rerun passed.

entries.title: Add durable lobby leave, ready, and database readiness
entries.description: Members can leave a durable lobby and set ready or unready. GET /health stays {status: ok}. GET /ready checks the database. Original lobby behavior stays unknown.
